hero.titleLine1: Get your training content into WalkMe Learning Arc —
hero.body: Already have a SCORM package from SAP Enable Now? We validate it and fix what we safely can. Have a PDF, Word doc, slide deck, web page, image, audio, or video instead? We package it into a SCORM course for you. Either way, you get a package WalkMe Learning Arc will actually track correctly.

problem.title: SAP Enable Now exports don't import cleanly — and not everything is SCORM to begin with
problem.body1Prefix: SAP Enable Now can export learning packages as SCORM, but WalkMe Learning Arc only accepts SCORM 1.2 ZIP files — and real-world exports commonly fail or track badly once imported: the wrong SCORM version, a missing or mis-cased launch file, and content marked as
problem.body2: And plenty of useful training material was never SCORM at all — a PDF guide, a Word doc, a recorded walkthrough video, a slide deck, a one-off web page, a screenshot, or a narrated audio clip. Getting any of that into WalkMe Learning Arc normally means repackaging it by hand. SENtoArc does that part too.

steps.title: Upload
steps.body: A SCORM ZIP from SEN, or a PDF, Word doc, video, slide deck, web page, image, or audio clip.

steps.title: Validate or package
steps.body: SCORM gets checked for version, manifest, launch file, and scormtype issues. Everything else gets built into a fresh SCORM 1.2 course.

steps.title: Auto-fix
steps.body: Safe fixes are applied automatically; anything risky is flagged instead of guessed.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Get back a SCORM package ready for WalkMe, plus a per-package report.

pricingTeaser.title: Simple pricing
pricingTeaser.body: Try it free on a few files, no risk. Buy a Project Pack for a one-off migration, or Enterprise Migration if you're moving a full SAP catalog with multiple teams.

items.a: A SCORM ZIP that SAP Enable Now itself exported (we don't read SEN's internal workspace format, only its SCORM output), or a PDF, Word document (.docx/.doc), PowerPoint (.pptx/.ppt), HTML page, image (PNG/JPG/GIF/SVG), audio file (MP3/WAV), or video (MP4/WebM/MOV) to be packaged into SCORM from scratch.

items.q: Does PDF/video/slide packaging look the same as a real SCORM course?
items.a: It's a simple, single-screen launch page that embeds your content and tracks completion — for video and audio, automatically when playback ends; for everything else, with a Mark Complete button. Word and PowerPoint files currently link out for download rather than rendering in the browser.
No — some issues (like SCORM 2004 sequencing that can't be safely downgraded) are flagged rather than guessed at, with a clear explanation in the report.
No. Uploaded and fixed files are automatically deleted after a retention period tied to your plan (see pricing for details).
